desc:
Escape Aswang Obby! 👹🌙

Can you survive the night and finish the obby before the Aswang finds you?

Run, jump, climb, and use your timing to escape through fun Filipino-inspired obstacle courses. When night comes, the Aswang begins to chase! Hide inside a Kubo to stay safe, or use the Pray ability to avoid being targeted.

This game is inspired by Filipino folklore and made as a fun adventure for all ages.

⚡ Game Features:

👹 Filipino folklore-inspired Aswang chase
🏃 Fun obby challenges with jumps, traps, and parkour
🌙 Day and night survival gameplay
🏠 Hide inside a Kubo to stay safe
🙏 Use Pray to avoid being targeted
🎉 Play solo or race with friends
⭐ More levels and updates coming soon

What kids can learn:

🧠 Quick thinking and decision-making
🤝 Teamwork when playing with friends
🏃 Timing, patience, and problem-solving
🇵🇭 A fun introduction to Filipino folklore and culture
🙏 Respect for traditional beliefs and stories

Can you escape the Aswang and reach the end?

👍
